messages:
nora_sales: Heads up — StellarWorks procurement says their AP system will only accept vendor SKU labels that match their internal chart of accounts. They plan to submit PO referencing "Stellar-Redwood-Monthly" instead of our marketplace SKU. They still expect the committed discount for the POC.
diego_dealdesk: Ok. Marketplace attribution requires our offer_id+sku. If their PO doesn't include those, auto-commit detection will fail. Two paths: Private Offer that exposes mapped SKUs, or accept PO and do manual attribution + retro credit if needed.
anya_finance: Finance prefers Private Offer for clean auditing, but if customer needs start this week we can approve a one-time manual allocation. Required: signed customer acknowledgment, credit cap, GL codes, and a 45-day claim window.
sam_se: Technical note — some marketplaces allow a custom invoice field for partner-defined metadata. If the buyer can add the marketplace offer id in a PO comment field that could keep automation intact. Can procurement do that?
nora_sales: Buyer says their template is locked and can't add freeform fields. They can, however, include a line item description. They asked if including our offer id inside the description (e.g., "offer_aws_redwood_09") would be enough.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: Provider behavior varies. AWS picks up offer id in line-item metadata if present; Azure/GC may not. Private Offer mapping is the most reliable. See internal: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/ops (access control applies).
diego_dealdesk: Draft exception language: "Redwood will accept customer PO referencing their internal SKU label and will manually attribute charges to the committed marketplace SKU for Jun 2026. If marketplace metering fails to map charges, Redwood will issue a one-time credit (max $15,000) within 45 days following invoice, subject to receipt of a signed buyer acknowledgement and audit rights." Need legal + finance signoff.
anya_finance: GL codes: REV_MARKET_02 for revenue, CREDIT_RETRO_02 for credits. Accounting needs signed ack before processing any retro credit. Finance ok with $15k cap for this POC.
sam_se: Here's a minimal mapping snippet for billing to paste into ticket:
```
offer_id: offer_aws_redwood_09
marketplace_sku: redwood.marketplace.stellar.v1
customer_label: "Stellar-Redwood-Monthly"
billing_entity: redwood-aws-prod
note: manual attribution for Jun 2026 POC
```
diego_dealdesk: Circulating to legal now. If legal approves one-time exception we accept PO and log manual attribution steps in SFDC. If legal declines, we initiate Private Offer (ETA 48-72h).
nora_sales: Customer says they'll sign an ack immediately if we accept PO today. They need the POC to start tomorrow.
diego_dealdesk: Legal replied — need explicit 45-day window and statement of audit rights; also require buyer ack to include clause allowing Redwood to access invoice detail for verification. We've updated the draft.
anya_finance: Finance confirmed 45 days and the $15k cap. Accounting will open a ticket to track potential retro credit and attach GL codes.
nora_sales: Customer uploaded signed acknowledgement PDF and the PO to SFDC. Sharing file link in CRM. Will start POC once deal desk confirms.
diego_dealdesk: Deal desk approves one-time manual attribution with the defined cap and audit language. Recording approvals: diego_dealdesk, anya_finance, legal (via legal-bot). Proceed to accept PO and monitor first invoice.
sam_se: I'll monitor the marketplace invoice feed and flag any unmatched line items. If metering fails we will trigger the credit process with accounting.
nora_sales: Thanks all — starting POC tomorrow. Please ping here if anything shows up on invoice or accounting needs more info. :rocket:
